channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Best of the Emerald Coast: Grand Boulevard Celebration of Local Excellence (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/8 | Grand Boulevard at Sandestin | No published price. Grand Boulevard at Sandestin hosts this annual celebration honoring local businesses and organizations chosen for the Best of the Emerald Coast program. It returns to the district on Thursday, October 8.

item.title: Draconid Meteor Shower: the one that happens at bedtime (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thu 10/08/2026 · from dark, best in the first hours | Your own yard, or Big Lagoon State Park for a darker sky | Free. Nearly every meteor shower asks you to be awake at three in the morning. The Draconids do not: the radiant is highest as the sky goes dark, so the best hour is the one right after dinner. The moon is a four percent crescent that does not rise until quarter to five, which means the sky is as black as it gets all month.

item.title: Free Open Mic Comedy at Talk to the Moon Comedy Club (THU 10/8)
item.description: Wednesdays and Thursdays · start time not posted | Talk to the Moon Comedy Club | Free. Talk to the Moon Comedy Club sits in the back of Mathieson Brewing Company and runs free open mic comedy shows on Wednesdays and Thursdays. Comedians use the stage to test new material in front of a live audience. The club's page does not post start times, so check its site or call before driving.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Indios Amigos Traveling Exhibit at Gulf Breeze and Pace Libraries (THU 10/8)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 to Saturday 10/10 at Gulf Breeze · Monday 10/12 to Saturday 10/17 at Pace | Gulf Breeze Library, then Pace Library | No published price. Gulf Breeze Library and then Pace Library host a bilingual traveling exhibit from the Florida Public Archaeology Network for Hispanic Heritage Month. It tells the story of the Aztec artisans and warriors who sailed with Tristan de Luna's 1559 expedition to Pensacola. The display stays up all week at each branch, so it fits a quick stop on a library visit.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (THU 10/8)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (THU 10/8)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Karaoke Block: The Block (THU 10/8)
item.description: Wed-Sat · from 6 PM (Thu 8 PM) | The Block | Free. The Sports & Karaoke room at The Block runs Wednesday through Saturday, opening at 6 (8 on Thursday) and going late. It is downtown Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (THU 10/8)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (THU 10/8)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (THU 10/8)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (THU 10/8)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (THU 10/8)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: The Boardwalk Columbus Day Weekend Celebration (THU 10/8)
item.description: Mon 10/5 to Sun 10/11 · see the daily schedule | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island runs a week of Columbus Day programming from October 5 to October 11, new for 2026. The schedule is a pirate show on Monday from 5:30 PM to 8:00 PM, a movie on the beach on Tuesday at 8:00 PM, karaoke on Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and karaoke followed by a fireworks show on Sunday.

item.title: UWF Women's Soccer vs Lipscomb (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/8 · 11:00 AM (moved up from 6 PM for Isaias) | UWF Soccer Complex | from $3. University of West Florida women's soccer hosts Lipscomb at the UWF Soccer Complex, part of the program's debut NCAA Division I season. General admission is five dollars, seniors, military and visiting students pay three dollars, and UWF students, faculty and staff get in free. So do children under six and youth in team uniform. The schedule doesn't publish an end time, so plan for a two-hour game.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (THU 10/8)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Rise and Shine Breakfast (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/8 · 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM | St. Ann Catholic Parish | from $15. The Gulf Breeze Area Chamber's networking breakfast pairs a hot meal with a short program at St. Ann Catholic Parish. RSVP ahead for the member or nonmember rate; walking in without an RSVP costs the nonmember rate at the door.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (THU 10/8)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (THU 10/8)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (THU 10/8)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (THU 10/8)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (THU 10/8)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Yoga Breeze (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays · 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. Yoga Breeze is a gentle Hatha yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center, built around flexibility, balance, posture and joint friendly movement. The city says it suits all skill levels, not just experienced practitioners. It asks a $3 donation.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (THU 10/8)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (THU 10/8)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Friends of the Fairhope Library Book Sale: October (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/8 · 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM | Fairhope Public Library, Lobby and Giddens Conference Center | No published price. Fairhope Public Library's lobby and Giddens Conference Center host the Friends of the Fairhope Library Book Sale, Thursday from 9 AM to 3 PM. Tables carry fiction, nonfiction, children's books, DVDs, artwork and puzzles, all donated. The sale returns on the second Thursday of every month.

item.title: Indios Amigos: Traveling Exhibit at the Valparaiso Library (THU 10/8)
item.description: Mon 10/5 to Fri 10/9 · 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Valparaiso Library | No published price. The Valparaiso Library hosts Indios Amigos, a traveling exhibit made by the Florida Public Archaeology Network and the UWF Archaeology Institute, for Hispanic Heritage Month. The library says this is the only Okaloosa County stop for the exhibit, and it is open 9 AM to 5 PM through Friday, October 9. The listing is for families and everyone.

item.title: Baby Bookworms Lapsit Story Time @ the Library (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays · 9:30 AM to 10:00 AM | Niceville Public Library: Youth Services Program Room | No published price. Niceville Public Library's Youth Services Program Room offers a lapsit story time built around music, stories and rhymes for infants and pre-walkers with their caregivers. The library holds this session Thursday mornings at 9:30 AM.

item.title: Chair Yoga (THU 10/8)
item.description: 9:45 AM to 10:45 AM | Niceville Senior Center | from $3. This Chair Yoga class at the Niceville Senior Center mixes seated poses with supported standing work. It aims at posture, flexibility, core strength, joint mobility, balance, stability and stress reduction. It asks a $3 donation and repeats every Tuesday and Thursday morning, for members age 55 and up.

item.title: Ages 3 to 5 Storytime Class at Crestview Library (THU 10/8)
item.description: Wednesdays or Thursdays · 10:00 AM | Crestview Library: Story Room | No published price. Crestview Library holds a weekly storytime class for preschoolers, with families choosing either the Wednesday or the Thursday session at 10:00 AM. Each class has stories, music, movement and a craft around a theme, such as Silly on October 14 or 15 and Farm Fun on October 21 or 22. Younger siblings and older children are welcome.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (THU 10/8)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.

item.title: Shake, Rattle, & Read Storytime at West (THU 10/8)
item.description: 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library's Shake, Rattle, & Read Storytime pairs books with music and movement for young children and their caregivers. The library frames it as a chance for little ones to read, move, and build early literacy skills together. The library lists it every Wednesday and Thursday morning in the West Regional meeting room.

item.title: iPhone & iPad (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays · 10:15 AM to 11:15 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This class at the Niceville Senior Center walks members through iPhone and iPad navigation, ways to optimize the device and its online safety features. It runs Thursday mid morning and repeats on multiple Thursdays.

item.title: Baby Bookworms Toddler Story Time @ the Library (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays · 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Public Library: Youth Services Program Room | No published price. Niceville Public Library's Youth Services Program Room runs a toddler story time with stories, music and rhymes for mobile children under age 3 and their caregivers. The library holds this session Thursday mornings at 10:30 AM, right after the lapsit program.

item.title: Children: Pre-K Storytime (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursdays · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Daphne Public Library | No published price. Pre-K Storytime runs every Thursday morning at Daphne Public Library, with five sessions across October at the same 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM hour. It's built for preschool-age children rather than the whole family.

item.title: Mini Makers and Experimenters Lab (THU 10/8)
item.description: Thursday 10/8 · 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM | Emerald Coast Science Center | from $13. This preschool activity hour at the Emerald Coast Science Center is built for ages 3 to 5, though the whole family is welcome to join in. Each session is a different hands-on activity, included in general admission, and reservations are required since the room has limited spots. It is a shorter, gentler session than the center's regular Maker Days for older kids.

item.title: Story Times at Mary Esther Library (THU 10/8)
item.description: Baby and Toddler Wednesdays · 3 to 6 Year Olds Thursdays · 10:30 AM | Mary Esther Library | No published price. Mary Esther Library holds two weekly storytimes: Baby and Toddler Story Time on Wednesdays and Story Time for 3 to 6 year olds on Thursdays, both at 10:30 AM. The Thursday session offers songs, stories and activities, and families can stay for free play and socializing afterward. No registration is required, and older and younger siblings are welcome.
